words: At D1 after a rewarded trip to S2: high after the rare a1->S2 route; after a2->S2 near zero, rising late with the clock.
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 r') ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S2 r') * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0)
